stories.head: Apple details learned retrieval for faster RAG
stories.date: Research highlight published November 5, 2026; underlying paper July 2026
stories.fact: Apple describes SupportNet cluster routing and KeyNet query mapping, trained offline for a fixed key database and a known query distribution.
stories.why: Benchmark recall, end-to-end latency and query drift on your own research archive before replacing retrieval infrastructure.
stories.unc: Reported gains are dataset- and setup-dependent; the highlight explains existing research rather than a newly released trading tool.
labels: KeyNet: map queries toward likely matches
Offline training for a fixed key database
Evaluate recall, latency and query drift
stories.alt: Conceptual labels distinguish SupportNet cluster routing from KeyNet query mapping and list offline-training and evaluation requirements.

stories.head: A bounded quant research loop makes rejection a first-class result
stories.fact: Henry Zhang describes a loop in which an LLM proposes declarative hypotheses while trusted code applies acceptance gates and a one-use chronological holdout. Most reported hypotheses fail.
stories.why: Separate proposal generation from evaluation authority; retain refusals and failed trials, and lock final tests before opening results.
stories.unc: Independent preprint and author-reported campaigns; this is a reference design, not proof that an automated strategy will earn returns.
stories.alt: Conceptual evidence gates separate LLM proposals, trusted evaluation, one-use holdout and a ledger of failures.

stories.head: Nasdaq futures rebound after Thursday’s technology selloff
stories.fact: Reuters reports Dow futures −0.91%, S&P 500 futures +0.29% and Nasdaq-100 futures +1.41% at 6:24 a.m. EST, after Thursday’s sharp technology-led decline.
stories.why: Stress two-way gaps and refresh SPY/QQQ relative risk; a rebound does not establish restored market depth.
stories.unc: Earlier press snapshot, not executable quotes; regulation-related explanations are reported market interpretations, not established causality.
stories.alt: Zero-centered bars show Dow futures down 0.91%, S&P 500 futures up 0.29% and Nasdaq-100 futures up 1.41% at 5:24 a.m. CST November 6.

stories.head: October jobs report is today’s key premarket event
stories.fact: BLS schedules the October 2026 Employment Situation for November 6 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern, or 7:30 a.m. CST.
stories.why: Reset labor-sensitive signals only when the release arrives; evaluate payrolls, unemployment, earnings and revisions jointly.
stories.unc: Results and surprises were unknown at cutoff. The release does not mechanically determine the Federal Reserve’s next decision.
stories.credit: BLS Employment Situation release schedule, checked November 6, 2026
stories.alt: Calendar diagram identifies the October reference month and November 6 release at 7:30 a.m. CST, with results unknown at cutoff.

stories.head: Airbnb reports faster revenue and booking growth
stories.fact: Airbnb reports Q3 revenue of $4.9 billion, up 19% year over year; gross booking value of $27.7 billion, up 21%; and nights and seats booked growth of 16%.
stories.why: Separate booking volume, pricing and recognized revenue when evaluating demand and operating performance.
stories.unc: Company-reported figures; booking value is not revenue, and non-GAAP measures and forward guidance require separate evaluation.
labels: Different measures; do not add together
stories.alt: Separate panels show Airbnb quarterly revenue, gross booking value and nights-and-seats growth, explicitly warning against adding unlike measures.
